target_definition: Next calendar day district rainfall maximum >= 64.5 mm, using the IMD heavy-rain threshold.
source: User-supplied Bihar historical rainfall dataset processed to district-day features
live_source: IMD-derived public district rainfall archive used by the live endpoint
important_limitation: This is a calibrated heavy-rainfall probability model, not a calibrated flood probability model. The overlapping rainfall+river flood-event records supplied for 2021-2026 contain too few positive events for a defensible joint flood classifier.
inundation: The live dashboard reports a hydrology-based spatial proxy only; no DEM, floodplain geometry, hydraulic solver, or validated inundation-depth model is included.
